events.title: The updated demo is live — build routes, roll an army
events.summary: The updated OrderlyWorld demo is now live on Steam. Build a supply chain, use deliveries to recruit defenders, and train matching heroes to unlock new skills. This 37-second video follows that loop across two tutorial missions. The demo includes T1–T3. Play it from the store page, and leave feedback in the pinned discussion if something gets in your way. Play the free demo and wishlist OrderlyWorld Demo feedback & bug reports Edited tutorial gameplay; music added in post.

events.title: New combo showcase: herd enemies into a line, one ray hits them all
events.summary: New hero combo from the current build: the Shepherd does not attack at all - he rings a bell and herds scattered enemies into a small pen. While he works, the Furnace holds fire. Once the pen is full, the Furnace locks on and fires a single ray through the whole line - every enemy inside takes full damage. events.title: One Full T1 Run: Water Formation, Fire Merge, Five Waves
events.summary: One complete T1 gameplay run in under 60 seconds. This A07 run starts at hero selection, then follows the full operation: build a Water supply line, pull and deploy three Water Slimes, switch production to Fire, merge three Fire Slimes, and survive all five waves. events.title: New gameplay: build the supply chain, then gamble it for heroes (A06)
events.summary: Your supply chain IS your firepower. In this new gameplay cut: lay out a low-poly factory (material to cut to sew to pack), wire the logistics with trucks and drones, and spend the goods you produce at the Weapon Station to pull random element heroes. Build & route — deeper supply chains unlock rarer pulls Draw — spend output for random water / fire / lightning heroes Combo — stand 3 of one element together for a tier-2 combo (3 water form a six-sided seal that locks a tank) Wishlist and follow

events.title: New gameplay: the full core loop — logistics to showdown
events.summary: In OrderlyWorld, your supply chain IS your weapon. Here's the full core loop, start to finish, in one shot: Draw delivery routes across the hex grid Trucks haul and drones airlift resources to the Weapon Station Draw element cards: Water, Fire, Lightning Deploy your elemental slimes They blast the Boss tank with ice, fire and lightning until it falls A low-poly cartoon logistics-strategy game, in active development. Wishlist OrderlyWorld to follow along: https://store.steampowered.com/app/484392
